# RychlyZivotopis.cz / RychlyZivotopis.sk

> Bilingual online application for CV and resume creation for Czech and Slovak users, including profession-specific guides, blog content, and PDF export.

RychlyZivotopis is a bilingual website focused on creating CVs quickly and simply, without registration.
The site includes profession guides with CV/resume samples, practical job-application advice, and a free tool for creating cover letters.
It also offers a paid workflow for exporting CVs as PDF with one-time payments (no membership), plus free edits for 24 hours after payment.
Profession pages may include sample preview data for illustration only.

## Product

- [Main Czech site](https://rychlyzivotopis.cz/cs): Czech version of the CV application and related content.
- [Main Slovak site](https://rychlyzivotopis.sk/sk): Slovak version of the CV application and related content.
- [Sitemap CZ](https://rychlyzivotopis.cz/sitemap.xml): Sitemap for Czech domain.
- [Sitemap SK](https://rychlyzivotopis.sk/sitemap.xml): Sitemap for Slovak domain.

## Profession Guides and CV Samples

- [Czech profession pages](https://rychlyzivotopis.cz/cs/profese/): Profession-specific CV guides with sample CV/resume content in Czech.
- [Slovak profession pages](https://rychlyzivotopis.sk/sk/profese/): Profession-specific CV guides with sample CV/resume content in Slovak.

## Notes

- The product offers paid PDF export of CVs.
- Pages contain structured data (WebPage, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage).
- CV preview on profession pages uses sample data for illustration.
- The website is available in Czech and Slovak language paths.
